_provenance.decision: D-04 / M-10 — OPEN, requires supervisor sign-off and a citation
_provenance.note: Only item 1 exists in the FYP report (Figure 4.6) and is reproduced verbatim. The remaining 35 were drafted in the idiom of the public-domain O*NET Interest Profiler (U.S. Department of Labor), which architecture.md §7.4 names as the appropriate basis. They are NOT a validated instrument and must be verified and cited in §3.4.1 of the thesis before any psychometric claim is made.
_provenance.structure: Six items per dimension, interleaved in R-I-A-S-E-C order so consecutive questions do not probe the same dimension. Dimension mapping is the answer key and is never served to the client (architecture.md §3.3.2C, AC-16).
_provenance.scoring: architecture.md §7.2 — plain sum of the six item values per dimension. No reverse-scored items; see supabase/functions/README.md.
